_comment: Resource catalogue (POC-4 §4). Seeded at startup; the API can update any row
afterwards, and quota signals from live 429s overwrite next_available_at.
Two credit classes, because they fail differently:
metered      — pay per token; concurrency is the real constraint.
subscription — a rolling plan window is the constraint. concurrency_limit
is a safety valve, not the quota. POC-3 E8 observed Claude
Pro answering rateLimitType=five_hour with an absolute
resetsAt, which is what next_available_at is filled from.
claude-code is its own resource class per §4 and is reachable only through
the POC-3 ACP or batch path (enforced by assertDispatchPathAllowed).

glm-4.7 pensiun 2026-08-21; opus/sonnet lewat jalur ACP claude-code. Kunci Gemini dan Groq sudah masuk sebagai Swarm secret dengan file-source SecretRef dan terverifikasi menjawab, jadi keduanya AVAILABLE.

quotaPolicy._unit_note: POC-3 E8: the CLI reports total_cost_usd (0.2385 for one batch run) but on a Pro plan that maps to no invoice — it is an API price estimate. Tokens against the plan window are what bind.
quotaPolicy._cache_note: E8 measured input 8 / output 1303 / cache_read 92663 / cache_creation 31860 on a single batch run. Cache read was ~12,000x fresh input, so any model that counts only input+output understates cost by two orders of magnitude.
